claim: No laboratório WSL2 HWA 10.2.8, /opt/hwa/TWS/Sfinal e /opt/hwa/TWS/config/Sfinal são iguais, enquanto /opt/hwa/TWS/Sfinal2 difere na dependência do stream FINAL: Sfinal usa FOLLOWS MDMXA#FINAL.SWITCHPLAN PREVIOUS e Sfinal2 usa a janela de dependência de MDMXA#FINALPOSTREPORTS.UPDATESTATS do ciclo anterior.
supporting_quote: diff Sfinal vs config/Sfinal: no differences; diff Sfinal vs Sfinal2: dependency line differs.
notes: This is a lab observation, not a general product claim. No database mutation was performed.

claim: No laboratório WSL2 HWA 10.2.8, os objetos FINAL e FINALPOSTREPORTS no banco correspondem à variante Sfinal, não à dependência alternativa de Sfinal2; o FINAL armazenado contém FOLLOWS MDMXA#FINAL.SWITCHPLAN PREVIOUS e FINALPOSTREPORTS contém FOLLOWS MDMXA#FINAL.SWITCHPLAN PREVIOUS.
source_url: local read-only composer display of MDMXA#FINAL and MDMXA#FINALPOSTREPORTS
supporting_quote: FINAL: FOLLOWS MDMXA#FINAL.SWITCHPLAN PREVIOUS; FINALPOSTREPORTS: FOLLOWS MDMXA#FINAL.SWITCHPLAN PREVIOUS.
notes: The result establishes which dependency variant is installed; it does not establish that Sfinal2 would select planman crt.

claim: No laboratório WSL2 HWA 10.2.8, o último FINAL executado concluiu STARTAPPSERVER, MAKEPLAN, SWITCHPLAN, CHECKSYNC, CREATEPOSTREPORTS e UPDATESTATS com código 0; o MAKEPLAN registrou planman ext, AWSJCL062I, e o SWITCHPLAN registrou atualização do run number e término com Exit Status 0.
supporting_quote: Running planman ext; AWSJCL062I The production plan (Symnew) has been successfully extended; AWSJCL065I Run number has been successfully updated; Exit Status 0.
notes: This validates the observed cycle only.

claim: In HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 Distributed, the optional Sfinal file supplies FINAL and FINALPOSTREPORTS job streams for automating production plan processing; FINAL runs the sequence corresponding to JnextPlan and FINALPOSTREPORTS follows successful SWITCHPLAN and includes CHECKSYNC for plan synchronization.
supporting_quote: The FINAL job stream runs the sequence of script files described in JnextPlan... FINALPOSTREPORTS ... starts only when the last job listed in FINAL (SWITCHPLAN) has completed successfully... includes CHECKSYNC.
notes: Official documentation supports the role and ordering, not the local Sfinal2 variant as a universal requirement.

claim: In HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, customized FINAL and FINALPOSTREPORTS definitions must be merged with the current Sfinal definitions and applied without discarding existing customizations; after updating the definitions, old instances may need to be canceled and new instances submitted according to the documented procedure.
source_title: Customizing and submitting the optional FINAL job stream
supporting_quote: Merge the job streams with file Sfinal so the new definitions have the same customization plus the new required attributes... delete current final job stream instances and submit the new instances.
notes: Changing local FINAL definitions is an operational change; validate in a lab and approve before applying to an active plan.
